name: fontconfig
notes: Added 2026-10-11 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B3: the bundled Skia (Source/ThirdParty/skia/CMakeLists.txt) and WebKit's Skia font backend (WebCore/platform/graphics/skia/FontCacheSkia.cpp, SkiaSystemFallbackFontCache.cpp) use fontconfig on every platform that is not Android or Windows, so the 'no fontconfig' decision D6 could not be kept without patching WebKit. The library is built and linked; the font set it sees is controlled by the embedder's FcConfig (FONTCONFIG_FILE/FONTCONFIG_PATH, or crtweb's own).

The font and cache directories point under the port prefix; --disable-cache-build keeps the build from running fc-cache with the target binary during install. gperf is the CRT gperf port (the tarball ships generated hash tables only for some objects).
